properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured; one pair unseparated): record_finding carries three kinds of record, observations, projections and markers (the adopt skill's deferral marker, an agent's fallback awaiting the owner), and `basis` names only the first two. Omitted, it is written `measured`. In the field this produced intent-owed markers stamped `forecast` to avoid claiming a runtime measurement, and one record left unwritten. Unchanged on main
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05 (tool surface). Binaries: 0.76.0 and 0.78.0 release builds, and main at e7e304d (reports 0.78.0); scratch stores under the hub session's scratchpad, isolated HOME.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words, two entries on 0.76.0. 2026-10-01: a record_finding DEFERRAL with basis 'inferred' was refused; "Omitting it materialized `measured`; later intent-owed markers used `forecast` to avoid implying a runtime measurement." 2026-10-02: "the finding (an agent-chosen fallback awaiting owner word, neither measured nor forecast) had no fitting `basis` and was left unrecorded. Inferred: record_finding has no home for 'observed by reading the code'." NOT AFFECTED: the shape refusals (basis, confidence) now arrive together in one round trip (0.78.0, #656).

② PRECEDENT: fact:root-cause-basis-names-four-value-sets-around-a-temporal-fact-and-provenance-a-fifth-2026-10-02 recorded the overload of the word `basis` and left a rename to Anthony. It did not record what agents then WRITE. That is new here: a value set with no fitting member gets a wrong member or no record.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the vocabulary has no value for "read in the code" or "a marker, not an observation"; (b) a home exists (basis measured + `source` naming the file; an exploratory Decision for a choice awaiting the owner) and nothing at the call names it; (c) the reporter misread `measured`; (d) the observation is wrong.

⑤ MEASURED on main. record_finding.basis is enum [measured, forecast], described "`measured` (it records something that happened) or `forecast` (it projects something expected to). Defaults to `measured`, which is what a finding is." TemporalFact has no provenance (set_provenance on a fact: "no such property on `TemporalFact`; it is declared on Requirement, Capability, Component, Interface"). `source` exists ("WHO OR WHAT the fact's value came from"). The served adopt skill (getting-started/skills/adopt/SKILL.md ~293) routes its deferral marker through record_finding with fact_type deferred_derivation and says nothing about basis, so every marker it asks for is written `measured` by default. No served skill text routes a code-read observation or an agent's provisional choice anywhere (grep of the skills). (d) is refuted.

④ (a) and (b) predict the same observation and cannot be separated by a measurement: which one is true depends on what `measured` is meant to cover, which is vocabulary and the owner's word (rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word). Recorded unseparated.

⑥ CLASS: one node type is used for records of different kinds, and the field that should tell them apart names the kinds of one (observed vs projected). The default fills the gap with the wrong word, silently. The adopt skill's own marker is the instance reflow2 writes itself.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: how many deferral markers in real designs carry basis `forecast` or the default `measured`; whether readiness or roadmap reads treat a `forecast` marker as a projection.
